Title: User submits valid name and phone number on User Details Form
Preconditions: App is running (streamlit run ui/app.py) and the sidebar navigation is visible
Steps: 1. Open the app in a browser | 2. In the sidebar, click "User Details Form" | 3. Enter a valid name in the Name field | 4. Enter a valid phone number in the Phone Number field | 5. Click the Submit button
Expected Result: A green success message is shown: "Thank you, Radhika Yadgire! Your details have been submitted."

Title: Navigate from Contact Us page to User Details Form and submit details
Preconditions: App is running and sidebar shows Home, Contact Us, User Details Form options
Steps: 1. Launch the app (lands on Home page) | 2. Click "Contact Us" in the sidebar and verify address/email/phone are displayed | 3. Click "User Details Form" in the sidebar directly after Contact Us | 4. Fill in Name and Phone Number fields | 5. Click Submit | 6. Verify success message appears
Expected Result: User is able to move from Contact Us to User Details Form via sidebar, the form renders below Contact Us in navigation order, and submission succeeds with a success message

Title: Phone number with minimum allowed length (7 digits) is accepted
Preconditions: App is running and User Details Form page is open
Steps: 1. Navigate to User Details Form | 2. Enter a valid name | 3. Enter a 7-character numeric phone number | 4. Click Submit
Expected Result: Form accepts the 7-digit phone number as valid and shows the success message (boundary of the 7-15 character regex range)

Title: Form accepts phone numbers containing +, -, and spaces
Preconditions: App is running and User Details Form page is open
Steps: 1. Navigate to User Details Form | 2. Enter a valid name | 3. Enter a phone number containing +, -, and spaces within 7-15 characters | 4. Click Submit
Expected Result: Form validates the phone number successfully (matches regex [0-9+\-\s]{7,15}) and displays the success message

Title: Submitting the form with empty Name and Phone Number fields shows validation errors
Preconditions: App is running and User Details Form page is open
Steps: 1. Navigate to User Details Form | 2. Leave the Name field blank | 3. Leave the Phone Number field blank | 4. Click Submit
Expected Result: Two red error messages are displayed: "Name is required." and "Phone number is required." and no success message is shown

Title: Submitting an invalid (non-numeric/too short) phone number shows a validation error
Preconditions: App is running and User Details Form page is open
Steps: 1. Navigate to User Details Form | 2. Enter a valid name | 3. Enter a phone number containing letters or fewer than 7 valid characters | 4. Click Submit
Expected Result: A red error message "Please enter a valid phone number." is displayed and no success message is shown
